faq.q: Which public schools are in the Terra Nova pocket?
faq.a: Spul'u'kwuks Elementary at 5999 Blanshard Drive is physically inside the pocket; for the sample address 5999 Blanshard Drive, the SD38 locator gives Spul'u'kwuks Elementary and Burnett Secondary, and SD38 has no middle tier — catchments are address-based, so check the exact address.

faq.q: How is Terra Nova reached by transit?
faq.a: Bus service on No. 1 Road and Westminster Highway connects the pocket to Richmond–Brighouse Station on the Canada Line; there is no Canada Line station inside the sub-area.

faq.q: Can a farm parcel beside the pocket have a second dwelling?
faq.a: Agricultural Land Commission guidance allows one principal residence and, if the regulation conditions are met, one additional residence per parcel in the Agricultural Land Reserve, and Richmond AG1 zoning also lists a secondary suite as a secondary use.

faq.q: What flood protection applies in Terra Nova?
faq.a: The City states Richmond has a perimeter dike system with drainage pump stations, designed for a 1:500 event, with dike raising from 3.5 metres to 4.7 metres under way; Bylaw 8204 also sets dike setbacks and a flood plain construction level.

Terra Nova Rural Park, 2631 Westminster Highway — a 63-acre site with trails, the Adventure Play Environment and the Sharing Farm, on the Pacific Flyway beside the Sturgeon Bank Wildlife Management Area — plus the West Dyke Trail running south from the park to Garry Point Park.
